items.question: Did Harrowgate give the change of control notice that the MSA requires, and how long before completion?
items.answer:
Harrowgate gave the change of control notice required by the MSA. The notice was sent on 3 September 2026, informing Voss-Lindqvist AB of an expected change of control due to Pellucid Holdings plc's acquisition of Harrowgate Systems Inc. [1]

The notice was given 42 days before the expected completion date of 15 October 2026. [1] This exceeds the 30-day requirement under Clause 14.2 of the MSA. [2]

The notice was addressed to the General Counsel of Voss-Lindqvist AB, as required by Clause 22.1 of the MSA. [3]

items.question: What service credit applies to downtime, and what monthly fee is it calculated on?
items.answer:
The service credit for downtime is five percent (5%) of the monthly subscription fee for each full hour of unavailability below the required level [1].

Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month [1].

The monthly fee on which the service credit is calculated is USD 18,500 per month for the Harrowgate platform [2].
